# --- SwiftyEdit core (do not edit) ---
RewriteEngine On

# never execute scripts from upload folders - they only hold images and files
# (the upload whitelist already blocks these extensions, this is a second line
# of defense). Matches direct /assets/... URLs and the short aliases below.
RewriteRule ^(assets/)?(images|images_tmb|galleries|files|avatars|branding|uploads)/.*\.(php[0-9]?|phtml|phar|pht|phps|cgi|pl|py|sh)$ - [F,NC,L]

# pass the Authorization header on to PHP - with PHP-FPM/CGI Apache drops
# it otherwise (needed for API keys, see app/handlers/api-routes.php)
RewriteCond %{HTTP:Authorization} .
RewriteRule .* - [E=HTTP_AUTHORIZATION:%{HTTP:Authorization}]

RewriteRule ^images/(.*)$ assets/images/$1 [L]
RewriteRule ^images_tmb/(.*)$ assets/images_tmb/$1 [L]
RewriteRule ^galleries/(.*)$ assets/galleries/$1 [L]
RewriteRule ^files/(.*)$ assets/files/$1 [L]
RewriteRule ^avatars/(.*)$ assets/avatars/$1 [L]
RewriteRule ^themes/(.*)$ assets/themes/$1 [L]

RewriteRule ^rss/(.*)$ rss.php?type=$1 [L,QSA]
RewriteRule ^admin-xhr/(.*)$ admin_xhr.php?query=$1 [L,QSA]
RewriteRule ^admin/(.*)$ admin.php?query=$1 [L,QSA]
RewriteRule ^install/(.*)$ install.php?query=$1 [L,QSA]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-d
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ index.php?query=$1 [L,QSA]
# --- END SwiftyEdit core ---
# --- User custom rules (safe to edit) ---
